title: Lyft is paying $272.5M to settle lawsuit over how it classified drivers | TechCrunch
summary: The ballot measure provided a carve-out from Assembly Bill 5 , a state law passed in 2019 that required companies like DoorDash, Lyft, and Uber to classify gig workers as employees, entitling them to minimum wage, workers’ compensation, and other benefits.
